Hope you enjoy this release! I've always avoided working on Kisaki doujins because her oldish speech is a pain in the ass to understand and translate. However, when I came across this work of art, I decided it was the time. It was simply too cute and hot, but also short and with little dialogue, so I thought it was perfect. I expect it to have mistakes and things that simply sound weird, so all corrections are welcomed.
